summary: A 1965 R-6 tower north of Darrington, closed for years to vandalism, was restored by volunteers and reopened in 2022 as an overnight rental.

facts.design: R-6 cab on a 41-ft timber tower

access.note: Overnight recreation rental run by the Friends of North Mountain under a Forest Service special use permit; reservations go through the group. Potable water not available at the site.

visit.trail_note: Drive Forest Road 2811 about 6.5 miles beyond the sharp turn. When the gate is closed, TrailChick (2018 visit) describes a road walk of about 2.5 mi round trip with 443 ft gain.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Darrington Ranger District)

events.note: Fire camp; first fire observer lived in a tent, and the camp was the lookout's home through 1966
Current 41-ft R-6 timber tower. TrailChick and Discover Darrington say 1965; firelookout.com says 1966
Proposed for removal and officially closed to the public because of vandalism damage
Friends of North Mountain formed to restore the lookout
Listed for overnight rentals in summer 2021
Restoration complete after eight years and more than 100 volunteers; reopening ceremony on Wednesday, August 10, 2022

corrections.why: The tower is 41 ft (about 12.5 m) per firelookout.com, Discover Darrington and HeraldNet. No source gives 50 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1965 per TrailChick and Discover Darrington; 1966 per firelookout.com. The story gives both dates and does not pick one.
NHLR gives 3,757 ft (1,145 m), which matches the record. The Forest Service gives 3,760 ft, and TrailChick and Discover Darrington give 3,824 ft. The record figure is kept and flagged for the editor.
Friends formed in 2013 (TrailChick). Firelookout.com says restoration began in 2015. HeraldNet describes eight years of work ending in 2022. The story avoids giving a start year.

notes_for_editor: Record height 50.0 m is wrong (41 ft, about 12.5 m). Built year 1966 in the record is disputed: 1965 per two sources. Elevation 1145.1 m matches NHLR only. Staffing as_of 2006 is the last staffing observation (NHLR visit report); the current use is rental, which implies no fire staffing, but no 2026 staffing report was read. Access 'restricted' reflects a reservation-only rental, not a closure. The Forest Service page was last updated 2026-08-19. TrailChick's visit was in 2018, when the gate was closed for restoration.
